Team —

Quick heads up: two of the booth leads (Samir and Jen) just canceled their outbound flights due to family emergencies. EdgeConf ops flagged us this morning — they need coverage for Friday kickoff and the evening sponsor reception.

Can you both check the staffing matrix I attached and confirm who can pick up an overnight shift? Key constraints:
- Flights we can swap into are between SFO and LAS, evening departures only.
- We prefer someone who can cover the sponsor reception (6:00–9:30pm PST) and staff the booth morning shift (8:00–12:30pm PST).
- Hotel is the Vernex — we have two rooms on standby; trying to avoid individual last-minute rooms if we can consolidate.

I attached a quick staffing_matrix.xlsx and the current flight_itineraries.pdf for reference. If neither of you can take full coverage, propose a split shift and I’ll coordinate travel changes.

Thanks —
Jonas
